re_execution_2026_09_04.summary: On independent re-execution the mcs-05 reverse-ATP-synthase fix did NOT robustly reproduce the in-band biomass yield. At the same committed cap (4.5) two solve paths give different physiology, indicating FBA optimum degeneracy: the reverse-cap permits but does not force respiration.

committed_default_path_cap4.5.note: NON-respiring optimum: reverse pinned at the cap, forward ATP synthase 0 -> no respiratory ATP -> defect persists

re_execution_2026_09_04.interpretation: The ATP-synthase-in-reverse DIAGNOSIS is solid and independently valuable. The one-parameter reverse-cap FIX is not a robust correction: capping the reverse flux to 4.5 admits a non-respiring FBA optimum identical to the defect, so the in-band yield is solve-path dependent. A principled fix must additionally reward/force forward (respiratory) ATP synthase, not merely bound the reverse direction.
